meta.title: Three Kingdoms Archetype Quiz
meta.subtitle: Your historical archetype is written in your choices
meta.intro: Twelve quick questions reveal which Three Kingdoms figure you most resemble. There are no right answers—go with your first instinct.

questions.text: When something unexpected happens in the middle of a crisis, you…

options.text: Lead the charge at once
Watch first, then find an opening
Gather everyone and decide together
Step back until the situation is clearer

questions.text: A friend suddenly invites you out. You are more likely to…

options.text: Go without a second thought
Check the route before setting off
Invite a few more friends along
Stay home and enjoy some solitude

questions.text: When faced with a new challenge, your first reaction is to…

options.text: Give it a try right now
Do your homework first
Find someone to start with you
Wait for a better moment

questions.text: You suddenly have a free weekend. You would…

options.text: Plan an adventure right away
Slow down and reset your own rhythm
Call friends for a lively get-together
Read, daydream, or take a walk

questions.text: When persuading someone, what do you rely on most?

options.text: Explaining the logic clearly
Reading the other person's emotions
Bringing facts and evidence
Leaving space for them to reach the insight themselves

questions.text: When a team cannot agree, you…

options.text: State my proposal directly
Talk to people one by one and find common ground
Take a quick vote and settle it
Watch for who really holds the key

questions.text: When reading a history book, what interests you most?

options.text: What the people actually did
Why events unfolded that way
The outcome of the decisive battles
The choices the people never said aloud

questions.text: Which kind of decision-maker are you?

options.text: I make the call decisively
I lay the groundwork for a long time before acting
I say what I mean face to face
I know how to borrow strength and take the long way around

questions.text: How do you treat a long-term relationship?

options.text: Once I choose it, I protect it for the long haul
I keep it fresh with change
I value both promises and stability
Together when it works, apart when it does not

questions.text: When your plan is disrupted, you…

options.text: Find a way back to the original plan
Switch to another route immediately
Secure what is already in hand first
Treat the surprise as a new opportunity
A reliable foundation
Room to stay free
Familiar people and routines
The possibilities no one has seen yet

questions.text: What do people most often say about you?

options.text: Steady—you can count on them
Resourceful—there is always a fresh idea
Principled and trustworthy
Free-spirited and impossible to define

results.name: Cao Cao
results.title: The clearest strategist in a chaotic age
results.oneLiner: I would bear the world's blame before I give up the initiative.
results.desc: You look for order in confusion and understand the board before opportunity appears. Controversy does not scare you, because the important choices rarely come with perfect answers.
results.quote: "Raise a toast to the song—how short a human life is."
strengths: You make the call when it matters
blindspots: Your forcefulness can overlook other people's feelings

results.name: Zhuge Liang
results.title: The careful strategist who gave everything
results.oneLiner: Think through every step, and you earn the right to take the last one.
results.desc: You notice the details others miss and are willing to take a few extra steps for a long-term goal. Your reliability comes from preparation; your edge is hidden behind calm.
results.quote: "I will devote myself to my duty until my dying day."
strengths: You give a team a steady direction
blindspots: You sometimes miss the joy of improvisation

results.name: Lü Bu
results.title: The fierce general who runs on pure fire
results.oneLiner: Win this battle first; think about the next one later.
results.desc: You carry an energy no one can ignore and give everything once you choose a target. You dislike detours, but sincerity and drive keep opening doors.
results.quote: "Among men, Lü Bu; among horses, Red Hare."
strengths: Your speed of action is unmatched
You are willing to take risks
blindspots: You think about consequences after acting
A passing emotion can carry you away

results.name: Guan Yu
results.title: The proud general who puts loyalty first
results.oneLiner: I rode a thousand miles alone so I would not betray the loyalty in my heart.
results.desc: You have your own standards for people and situations, and rarely waver once you commit. You value loyalty and wish every promise carried the weight yours does.
results.quote: "The Peach Garden oath: together in life and death."
strengths: You take responsibility when it matters
blindspots: Pride makes it hard to bend
High standards can make you seem distant

results.name: Zhao Yun
results.title: The gentle yet steadfast undefeated general
results.oneLiner: The wind at Changban was fierce, but you always knew whom to protect.
results.desc: You do not need noise to prove yourself; you step forward when it truly matters. You can charge ahead and still sheathe your edge, making you a companion people trust.
strengths: You protect the people who matter
blindspots: You find it hard to ask for what you need

results.name: Liu Bei
results.title: The humane leader who turns hearts into a kingdom
results.oneLiner: The one who wins hearts truly owns a city that will not fall.
results.desc: You believe in the power of relationships and are willing to give people another chance. Your pull does not come from pressure; it makes people want to face hard things with you.
results.quote: "Do not do even the smallest evil; do not leave undone even the smallest good."
strengths: You know how to empathize and inspire
blindspots: You sometimes place too much hope in others

results.name: Zhou Yu
results.title: The elegant and brilliant commander of Red Cliffs
results.oneLiner: With mountains and valleys in your mind, you can calm the storm with a smile.
results.desc: You have taste and ambition; you may look relaxed, but the next move is already arranged in your mind. You stay graceful in complexity and turn strength into results with impeccable timing.
results.quote: "Amid laughter and conversation, the enemy's fleet turned to ash."
strengths: You control the pace with ease
blindspots: You demand too much of yourself
You dislike admitting when control is slipping

results.name: Sima Yi
results.title: The patient hunter who keeps his edge sheathed
results.oneLiner: The real winner is often revealed only at the very last moment.
results.desc: You do not rush to win applause; the final result matters more. You know how to wait and how to seize the turning point when everyone else lets down their guard.
results.quote: "Cultivate yourself through stillness; nurture virtue through frugality."
strengths: You recognize shifts in the situation
blindspots: Too much caution can keep you from speaking up
